title: Worker pool over a stream, with cancel
prompt:
Write `FetchOrders(ctx context.Context, ids <-chan int, workers int, get func(id int) Order) <-chan Order`.

- `workers` goroutines call the slow `get` for each id; results in any order.
- Close the output when `ids` is closed and all results are sent.
- When `ctx` is cancelled: start no new `get` calls, don't block on sending, close the output.

The `ids` stream may never end.
hint: Each worker `select`s on `ctx.Done()` both when receiving an id and when sending a result, and checks `ctx.Err()` before calling `get`.
